beats.narration_en: Same car, same speed. Watch what these two bumps do to it.
The short bump jolts the wheels in a flash; the long one lifts the car slowly.
At thirty kilometers per hour, the short bump hits about twice as hard.
At ten, the long hump turns gentle, but the short bump still jolts.
In this simulation the short bump is two to six times harsher at every speed.
It is not just the height. It is how quickly the road lifts your car.
